text: Imagine placing a QR code at your wedding…
And watching your guests scan it and upload all the beautiful photos they've captured.
And just like that, all those moments come together right inside your wedding website.
But it's not just photos. Your guests can also leave little messages, share voice notes, and react to the photos they're uploading.
And the best part? Even years later, you can come back to your wedding website, revisit these memories, and relive those beautiful moments all over again.
That's what I call Digital Wedding Memories.
Want this at your wedding too? DM me "MEMORIES" or comment below, and let's make it happen!
